# Foreign Key Relationships:
# - Users → Addresses (1:many)
# - Users → Shopping Carts (1:1)
# - Users → Payment Methods (1:many)
# - Users → Orders (1:many)
# - Users → Reviews (1:many)
# - Categories → Products (1:many)
# - Products → Cart Items (1:many)
# - Products → Order Items (1:many)
# - Products → Reviews (1:many)
# - Shopping Carts → Cart Items (1:many)
# - Orders → Order Items (1:many)
# - Payment Methods → Orders (1:many, optional)
# - Shipping Methods → Orders (1:many, optional)

# Notes:
# - All UUIDs are auto-generated by PostgreSQL using gen_random_uuid()
# - All timestamps use NOW() for current time
# - Password hashes are BCrypt format (example hashes provided)
# - Images are stored as JSONB arrays
# - All foreign key constraints are satisfied
# - Data is realistic and follows business logic
